reader.requirement: At --std 85 a VALUE clause on a group item must take only a figurative constant (including ALL literal and a symbolic-character) or a nonnumeric literal no longer than the group, must initialize the group's whole area as characters regardless of the subordinate items' descriptions (with the alphanumeric space fill, at the maximum ODO occurrences, and in every occurrence under an OCCURS), and a VALUE clause on any data item subordinate to that group must be refused (condition-name entries excepted).
reader.edition-search: grep for Edition.Edition/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry/Constructs./IsAtLeast/DialectBehavior in CheckGroupValueDeclarationsPass.cs, ValueSubject.cs, GroupImageCodec.cs, GroupValueSlicer.cs: none (binder.Edition used only for At/Error). In DataBinder.ValidateValueCategory the only edition consult (FigurativeAssociation.GateAllZeroAsNumeric) is on the NUMERIC elementary subject arm, not the group arm (the group arm is `case PicCategory.Alphanumeric when isNumeric && IsNumericLiteralForm(raw) && subject.IsGroup`).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same probes at --std 2023 print the same values (gv1) and the same refusals (gv2: 3 COBOL1657, 3 COBOL1702, 1 COBOL1740)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: 1985-GR-VI_5_15_6-3 and pb207_group_value_area_85 cover the area initialization (incl. REDEFINES under the group, ZEROS, space fill); pb206/pb4610/pb5215 cover size and condition-name neighbours. Not exercised: the refusal of a numeric literal at group level, the refusal of VALUE at a subordinate level, ALL literal / symbolic-character / QUOTE at group level, a group with an ODO table, a group under OCCURS

reader.notes: ValidateValueCategory refuses a numeric literal on a group subject, CheckGroupValueDeclarationsPass refuses a VALUE anywhere under a group-VALUE subject, and the GroupImageCodec/GroupValueSlicer path lays the literal's characters over the area and derives each member from its slice. Every probed form agrees with the 1985 text, with no edition branch on the path. The refusal messages cite §2023:13.18.63.3 SR13 at --std 85 (diagnostic citation only).

refuter.evidence: gv3.cob at --std 85: a group VALUE HIGH-VALUES over PIC 99 + PIC X equals the same group after MOVE HIGH-VALUES (W1 SAME), and the numeric member keeps the raw characters (MOVE N1 TO X2 gives HIGH-VALUES, W2 HV). A group VALUE "1" over PIC 9(3) + PIC ZZ9 equals MOVE "1" TO the group (W4 SAME) and shows [1     ][1  ][   ]. So the area is set as characters without regard to the members' categories or editing. VALUE "-12" over PIC S99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE gives -12, which tests negative. A nested group under VALUE LOW-VALUE equals LOW-VALUES. Refusals: gv4 group VALUE X"4142" (a hexadecimal literal is not a 1985 nonnumeric literal) -> COBOL0900; gv5 a subordinate COMP item -> COBOL1702, a subordinate JUSTIFIED item -> COBOL1702 (both GR4 neighbours), and a subordinate data-item VALUE beside an allowed 88 -> COBOL1702 citing SR13, with the 88 not refused. A grep of CheckGroupValueDeclarationsPass/GroupImageCodec/GroupValueSlicer for CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior|Constructs. found nothing, which agrees with the reader. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR3; OK §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR4.
